procedures.name: GetIsInvoicedStatus
procedures.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetIsInvoicedStatus]
    @IdSale INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Verificar si el registro existe
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [FusionSales]
        WHERE [SaleID] = @IdSale
    )
    BEGIN
        -- Retornar el valor del campo IsInvoiced
        SELECT [IsInvoiced]
        FROM [FusionSales]
        WHERE [SaleID] = @IdSale;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        -- Manejo para cuando no se encuentre el registro
        RAISERROR ('Registro con SaleID = %d no encontrado.', 16, 1, @IdSale);
    END
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetSalesByPumpNumber]
    @PumpNumber INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- ============================================================
    -- OBTENER VALOR DE VoxIsActive DESDE LA BD TPV
    -- ============================================================
    DECLARE @VoxIsActive INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 [VoxIsActive]
        FROM [TPV].[dbo].[Store]
    );

    SELECT TOP (200) 
        [SaleID],
        [PosNumber],
        [PumpNumber],

        CASE
            WHEN [HoseNumber] = 1 THEN 'A'
            WHEN [HoseNumber] = 2 THEN 'B'
            WHEN [HoseNumber] = 3 THEN 'C'
            WHEN [HoseNumber] = 4 THEN 'D'
        END AS [HoseNumber],

        CASE
            WHEN GradeNr = 1 THEN  'REGULAR'
            WHEN GradeNr = 2 THEN  'SUPER'
            WHEN GradeNr = 3 THEN  'DIESEL'
            WHEN GradeNr = 4 THEN  'DIESEL2'
            ELSE 'DESCONOCIDO'
        END AS Grade,

        [PPU] AS Precio,

        -- ============================================================
        -- SI VoxIsActive = 1 → USAR Amount/PPU CON 6 DECIMALES
        -- SI VoxIsActive = 0 → USAR Volume DE LA TABLA
        -- ============================================================
CASE 
    WHEN @VoxIsActive = 1 THEN 
        CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,6), ROUND([Amount] / NULLIF([PPU], 0), 6))
    ELSE 
        [Volume]
END AS Cantidad,


        CASE 
            WHEN [IsInvoiced] = 0 THEN 'Sin Facturar'
            WHEN [IsInvoiced] = 1 THEN 'Facturado'
            ELSE 'Estado Desconocido'
        END AS Estado,

        [Amount],

        CASE
            WHEN [IsInvoiced] = 1 THEN 'Finalizada'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, ISNULL([Date], GETDATE()), GETDATE()) > 30 
                 AND [IsInvoiced] = 0 THEN 'Atrasada'
            ELSE 'Libre'
        END AS Ciclo,

        [Date]-----
        ,
        -- CORRECCIÓN: Manejo seguro de Fecha
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, CAST([DateOfTransaction] AS VARCHAR), 112) AS [Fecha],

        -- CORRECCIÓN: Manejo seguro de Hora (asegurando formato HH:MM:SS)
-- Cambia tu lógica de Hora por esta:
CAST(
    CAST(
        STUFF(STUFF(RIGHT('000000' + CAST([TimeOfTransaction] AS VARCHAR), 6), 3, 0, ':'), 6, 0, ':') 
    AS TIME(0)
) AS TIME(0)) AS [Hora],

        CASE 
            WHEN [PaymentInfo] LIKE 'USER;%' THEN REPLACE([PaymentInfo], 'USER;', '')
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS [Despachador]
     

    FROM [FusionSales]
    WHERE [PumpNumber] = @PumpNumber
    ORDER BY [SaleID] DESC;
END;

procedures.name: GetSalesByPumpNumberAndHoseNumber
procedures.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetSalesByPumpNumberAndHoseNumber]
    @PumpNumber INT,
	@HoseNumber INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT TOP (100) 
        [SaleID],
        [PosNumber],
        [PumpNumber],
		CASE
		WHEN [HoseNumber]=1 THEN 'A'
		WHEN [HoseNumber]=2 THEN 'B'
		WHEN [HoseNumber]=3 THEN 'C'
        WHEN [HoseNumber]=3 THEN 'D' end as [HoseNumber]

        ,CASE
            WHEN GradeNr = 1 THEN  'REGULAR'
            WHEN GradeNr = 2 THEN  'SUPER'
            WHEN GradeNr = 3 THEN  'DIESEL'
            WHEN GradeNr = 4 THEN  'DIESEL2'
            ELSE 'DESCONOCIDO'
        END AS Grade,
		[PPU] as Precio,
[Volume] as Cantidad,
   
        CASE 
            WHEN [IsInvoiced] = 0 THEN 'Sin Facturar'
            WHEN [IsInvoiced] = 1 THEN 'Facturado'
            ELSE 'Estado Desconocido'
        END AS Estado
		     ,[Amount],
CASE
	WHEN [IsInvoiced] = 1 THEN 'Finalizada'
WHEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, ISNULL([Date], GETDATE()), GETDATE()) > 30 AND [IsInvoiced] = 0 THEN 'Atrasada'

    ELSE 'Libre'
END AS Ciclo,
[Date]

    FROM [FusionSales]
    WHERE [PumpNumber] = @PumpNumber AND [HoseNumber]=@HoseNumber
    ORDER BY [SaleID] desc;
END;
